result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice and receive a refund of prepaid post-termination fees, while Kubient’s convenience termination can be effective only at the end of the then-current term on 90 days’ notice. It also appropriately preserves accrued revenue during the notice period. However, granting Customer rights to terminate any Exhibit “in whole or in part” materially expands the termination right beyond what the playbook requires, so the revision is not minimal. Drafting is generally professional, though the Exhibit exception could be clarified to ensure no Exhibit permits Kubient to terminate for convenience mid-term, and the punctuation before subsection (b) should be corrected.
